snippet.title: Sisters of Solitude | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by true events, Sisters of Solitude is an 8-bit psychological horror game that takes players inside the abandoned convent of the Order of Our Lady of Solitude, where four sisters murdered their Mother Superior before mysteriously dying themselves. As a paranormal-obsessed teen armed with an EMF detector, tape recorder and instant camera, players investigate supernatural activity and collect evidence as they uncover the dark secrets surrounding the murder. Resources are limited, and every discovery could bring you closer to the truth. [Steam wishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4194770/Sisters_of_Solitude/]
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
